top_signals.title: Petroperu Chair Eyes Rare Profit, Investors for Minority Stake
top_signals.summary: Petroperu’s board will look to sell a minority stake in the ailing state-owned oil giant early next year, according to its chairman, who says the company is on track to notch its first annual profit since 2021.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
